intro: Speak with Coleman is a transitional task in Tirisfal Glades offered to champions who have proven their worth against the Scourge. Deathguard Dillinger directs capable warriors from the town square to the local tavern to assist Coleman Farthing with personal and factional vendettas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.
Coleman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the Forsaken's enemies.
You will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern Brill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, it is true. I have need for your skills in combat. My means are small, but my task aids both me and the Forsaken's cause. Do it, and your reward will be twofold.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
